node_map.label: Frozen geometry · public tier
node_map.message: A Gmsh mesh is frozen geometry in the public tier: its nodes do not follow the design, because the node map is part of the private tier (diff-brep). Use mesher='tetgen' for a mesh that follows the design, or install diff-brep.

feature_edges.label: Approximate · lattice
feature_edges.message: Feature edges are read off the dual-contouring lattice in the public tier, so they are approximate; exact edge curves are part of the private tier (diff-brep).

brep.label: Dual contouring · public tier
brep.message: Exact B-rep extraction is part of the private tier (diff-brep); the public tier has the dual-contour mesh only.

step_export.label: Faceted · public tier
step_export.message: STEP export is faceted in the public tier: triangles from dual contouring. Exact planes, cylinders and edge curves are part of the private tier (diff-brep).

drag.label: Unavailable · public tier
drag.message: Dragging a B-rep handle solves the design through the exact B-rep, which is part of the private tier (diff-brep).
